findings.evidenceJa: このままじゃ数で押されかねないから
findings.governingReading: かねない marks the danger of numbers pushing them back, motivating the source-targeting plan.
findings.explanation: Risk of being overwhelmed becomes inevitable eventual overwhelm.

findings.highlight: Caster knows Saber is way more powerful
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの強さがキャスターの予想以上だったにしろ
findings.governingReading: Even if Saber was stronger than Caster expected, Rin doubts that an unprepared assault would succeed.
findings.explanation: The source’s possible underestimation of Saber is again made into Caster’s knowledge of her superiority.

findings.highlight: don't seem to work against the attack from Saber's sword.

findings.explanation: The exclusive healing exception for Saber’s sword again loses only.
